label: No non-INFINITE_1 intellect comprehends an INFINITE_1 being, via COMPREHEND_2 (inference)
meaning: Let g be INFINITE_1 and x an intellect that is not INFINITE_1. If x stood in the primitive comprehension relation (COMPREHEND_1) to g, then by the sense bridge x would COMPREHEND_2 g, which the first premise excludes. Hence x does not COMPREHEND_1 g: the bridge 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being' (bbac932e). The senses are not identified; the only passage is the listed sense bridge. Conditional consequence; the sense bridge stays open, and the first premise is derived from four open premises.
